## Why this file is safe to redistribute

This profile is **generated algorithmically**, not copied from any vendor. Little CMS
constructs it from the sRGB colour space constants published in **IEC 61966-2-1**
(primaries, D50-adapted white point, and transfer curve). Those are published
mathematical constants and are not themselves copyrightable subject matter; the code
that generates the file is MIT-licensed.

This replaced an earlier build that embedded macOS's bundled
`/System/Library/ColorSync/Profiles/sRGB Profile.icc`. That file was functionally
correct but its redistribution rights were never confirmed — tracked as **RB-6** and
closed by this change.

## Regenerating

```python
from PIL import ImageCms   # Pillow, backed by MIT-licensed lcms2
```
